writeup.headline: Nu Holdings rates Hold as strong growth and margins are offset by a very weak share price trend.
writeup.thesis: Nu Holdings scores 49, a Hold, sitting just 5 points above the Sell line. The fundamentals that could be measured are decent: TTM revenue growth of 43.4% and a gross margin of 45.6% support growth and quality scores of 53 and 72, with stock-based pay at 2.4% of revenue and diluted share count up 0.7% year on year. Growth is cooling, though, slowing by 24.1 pp from the previous quarter. The main drag is the trend score of 7: the price is 17.5% below its 200-day average, 36.2% below its 52-week high and 23.8 pp behind SPY over the last 126 trading days. News is mildly positive (score 54) on analyst initiations and target raises, while balance sheet and valuation could not be scored and were left out of the rating.
key_risks: Revenue growth is decelerating sharply, slowing by 24.1 pp from the previous quarter
Persistent share price weakness, with shares down 22.8% from 12 months ago to 1 month ago
Heavy geographic concentration in Brazil, exposing results to its economy, currency and credit cycle
Pending Central Bank approval of the Banco Porto Real banking licence deal
Q3 results due 2026-11-12 could reset sentiment either way
what_would_change: A drop of 5 or more points, for example from further trend weakness or a growth slowdown in Q3 results, would move the rating to Sell
A rise of 16 points to reach Buy would need a clear recovery in the trend score alongside sustained growth
A Q3 results beat with guidance upgrades would lift the news and growth factors
Approval of the Brazilian banking licence or new regulatory issues could shift the news risk score
